rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a very poor-quality early blastocyst and acknowledges discordance in expansion, but it overstates visible details such as cytoplasmic stress/granularity and does not clearly describe the sparse peripheral TE and absent discernible ICM seen in the image.
Integrates maternal age, DOR, prior miscarriage, endometrial thickness, BMI, and paternal age/semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis in a clinically meaningful way.

Overall logic is clear, but there are notable issues: it incorrectly infers a 100% blastulation rate from 3 MII oocytes, labels prior miscarriage as 'proven implantation' without nuance, and makes some speculative causal claims about sperm DNA fragmentation and spindle defects.

Broadly aligned on poor prognosis counseling and avoiding biopsy of a poor-quality embryo, but includes several less guideline-based recommendations (routine GH, DHEA/CoQ10, IMSI, extending progesterone to 10-12 weeks) and some overconfident protocol suggestions.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer counseling, luteal support, follow-up, and future-cycle evaluation, though some suggestions are more speculative than evidence-based.
